$schema_note: Design Engine contract for Souq Bartaa. This file DOCUMENTS an existing, owner-approved system (DESIGN_BRIEF.md, approved 2026-08-30 from Direction C of docs/design-directions.html). It is not a new identity. Amend DESIGN_BRIEF.md first, then this file — never the other way round.
project: سوق برطعة — منصة مواقع التجار (chrome: «مرصد» / Marsad)
audience: صاحب محل في برطعة والضفة والداخل — جوال أولاً؛ ومشغّل المنصة الوحيد على شاشة كبيرة لساعات
sentence: feels like an instrument a shopkeeper reads their business off — not a marketing site with tables bolted on
physical_world: لوحة عدادات، ورق دفتر حسابات، خط مسطرة رفيع، إضاءة محل مضبوطة
kit_note: Nearest kit by category (SaaS/dashboard). The implementation predates the kit and is governed by DESIGN_BRIEF.md; forge is a reference for craft details only, never a source of tokens.
archetype: dark techno / terminal (de-cyberpunked) × swiss international grid

out: the nine storefront templates — each ships its own frozen token set; see storefront_templates below

excluded: Zain — a storefront face; reads soft rather than precise on a control surface
font_rules.kpi_face: IBM Plex Sans Arabic — dependable tabular figures; a column of money must align digit-for-digit

palette.derived_from: a ledger read in a lit shop: near-black green ground, one mint accent reserved for data and state
palette.accent_is_not_one_value: #5FD3A8 is 9.4:1 on #0F1513 and 1.7:1 on white. Light mode resolves the same hue family for its own ground.
palette.contrast_enforced_by: tests/unit/chrome-contrast.test.ts — 2 modes x 5 accents x 2 surfaces; body and button labels 4.5:1, ink-faint 3:1

hero: none — every page opens on PageHead (title, one-line context, one primary action) then straight to data. There is no marketing furniture on a control surface.

sources: merchant-uploaded product photography via the media library (R2/CDN)
template preview images for the appearance picker
imagery.treatment: merchant photos rendered as-is; placeholders are typographic, never a gray box

signature: the inline sparkline — every KPI card carries a 26px trend line of its own metric, inline SVG, currentColor, no library, no client JS
the corner bloom — one radial accent wash at 13% opacity, on the ACTIVE or PRIMARY card only; its whole job is to say 'this one'
the state hairline — status carried by a 2px rule on the card's inline-start edge in the state's hue, PLUS a text label; never hue alone
motion: budget 150ms ease-out, opacity and transform only; nothing changes layout on hover. Sparkline draws once per mount (600ms), KPI counts up on first paint only (400ms). Never animates page transitions, card entry, or anything on scroll. prefers-reduced-motion nulls all of it.
sections: empty state (icon + one line + one action)
differentiate_from: generic AI SaaS dashboards: Inter + purple gradient + glass cards + hero and three feature cards. Also the local cliché of black+gold 'luxury' and sky-blue 'tech'.
never: accent-coloured page furniture — the accent is for data and state only
hardcoded hex in a component — every colour comes from a token
Latin placeholder text — always real Arabic strings of varying length

locale_rules.copy: Arabic only, routed through the i18n layer — no hardcoded strings in components

a11y.known_gap: form-control borders draw from --sb*-rule* (~1.6:1) — WCAG 1.4.11 wants 3:1 for component boundaries. Inherited from Phase 1, measurable only on a rendered element, tracked for the axe-core e2e pass.

storefront_templates.rule: each ships a full token set in one file; tenant colour customisation writes tokens ONLY, guarded by an automatic WCAG AA contrast check that auto-adjusts lightness and reports it
storefront_templates.anti_reskin: nine palettes x nine type scales x three header postures x three footer forms — the chrome is a template axis, not a constant

perf_budget.fonts: preloaded + Arabic-subset, never full font files

stack: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript strict, plain CSS with a token layer (no Tailwind, no component library)
